Evoking fond childhood memories of playing video games in the 1990s, this keycap set is inspired by the translucent purple colourway of some gaming systems of this iconic era. name: A Design Candy Box Keycaps
sourceText:
Candy Box Keycaps are colorful keycaps designed by A Design and meant to capture that one generational candy box used to store needles, threads, and mementos that every household seemingly has.
Inspiration:
The design inspiration comes from a sentence: "The meaning of photos is to turn a moment into eternity. Recording makes memories richer. Photos also serve as evidence of happiness. When you look back and recall your emotions at that time, they make the memories more specific and vivid." It was because of this sentence that I realized, in addition to photos, I might be able to record that beautiful day in another way.
Why is it called a candy box? The original intention behind designing this set of keycaps was to store memories, just like the candy box at home. But instead of candy, it holds needles and thread, old photos, some cherished mementos, and beautiful memories we hold dear.

PBTfans Beluga Whale Keycaps are a slightly off-white, blank set utilizing PBTfan's PBT material. PBT material description can be found below.
PBTfans Beluga Whale Blank Keycaps Features:
Cherry Profile
Manufactured by PBTfans
PBT Material
Blank Legends
Thickness: 1.3mm
MX Compatible
PBTfans PBT Material Description:
The main material of the keycaps is PBT, but we have incorporated "glass microspheres" into the design. Unlike conventional PBT, this unique blend produces a clearer, crisper sound, giving it a Hi-Fi quality. The keycap thickness is approximately 1.3mm, and the surface texture offers a skin-like feel, distinctly different from our dual-color surface.
